$comment: Machine-readable form of the layering in docs/architecture.md §5, for the
Next.js + NestJS (Fastify) topology decided in ADR 0001.
Enforced by tools/check_boundaries.py, which runs in CI before lint or tests.
Internal imports are recognised two ways: the workspace alias '@convert/<layer>'
Change this file only in the same commit as an ADR that changes the layering.

contracts.purpose: Shared DTOs, error envelope, ULID helpers, pagination cursors, and the closed sets whose values are product rules. Every shared shape is a Zod schema, so a boundary can validate rather than trust (ADR 0044). The only package both web and api may import. Zod is its one dependency; nothing else.

core.purpose: Framework-free domain logic, entities, and ports. Invariants I1-I12 live here. No decorators, no ORM, no HTTP.

application.purpose: Use cases. Takes a Principal, enforces authorization and entitlements, writes activity rows. Shared by api and worker, so it must stay framework-free.

infra.purpose: Adapters that implement core ports: repositories, migrations, WhatsApp/SMS providers, queue, observability.

api.purpose: NestJS on the Fastify adapter. HTTP interface, webhook ingress, principal resolution, and later the Pro-tier public API. Thin: controllers call use cases.

worker.purpose: NestJS standalone application context. Campaign sends, reminder sweeps, provider event processing, read-model refresh.

web.purpose: Next.js App Router. UI plus BFF route handlers that hold the session and call the API server-side. Knows DTOs, never domain logic.

compositionRoots.$comment: Only these files may wire infra implementations into a runtime. Everything else receives ports by injection. Keeps the swap in ADR 0005 to one directory.
